The Home Of

Powder Friday

Our unique Friday-Monday operating schedule allows for snow to accumulate midweek while other resorts get tracked out. When the lifts begin to operate again on Friday morning at 10,000 feet, Eagle Point remains untouched, offering guests fresh tracks in pristine conditions. If we declare a #PowderFriday, then you know it is ON when the lifts start spinning at 9:30AM.

Sign Up for the eagle point newsletter

By signing up for the Eagle Point Newsletter, you consent to occasional emails about awesome stuff going on at the resort…like those 50″ storms we get.

Lift tickets

With Advanced Purchase Lift Tickets, the sooner you buy the more you save.  Shop for single and multi-day tickets and save up to 25%. Kids 12 and Under ski free at Eagle Point.

Rentals

Skyline Lodge Rental Shop offers a large selection of high-quality ski and snowboard gear, conveniently located by the slopes.
